source.title: EMSD, District Cooling Services Charges (rates under the District Cooling Services Ordinance, Cap. 624)
source.notes: Capacity charge = contract capacity x capacity rate (per month). Consumption charge = metered cooling energy x consumption rate. Capacity rate adjusts with the Composite CPI; consumption rate adjusts with the electricity tariff. A capacity overrun is charged at 1.1 x the capacity rate on the excess (LegCo Panel on Environmental Affairs paper, 17 July 2014); this tool assumes no overrun.

connection_rule.text: Connection is not a free choice here: all public developments and all private non-domestic developments in Kai Tak are required to connect to the Kai Tak DCS, a requirement written into the land-sale conditions. The district cooling result is therefore the expected case for new non-domestic buildings; the other options show what that requirement costs or saves against them.
connection_rule.source: Legislative Council Panel on Environmental Affairs, paper for the meeting of 28 April 2025; and 'Collection of Charges for District Cooling System at the Kai Tak Development', paper for discussion on 17 July 2014

service_area.basis: APPROXIMATION: Kai Tak OZP S/K22/9 planning scheme boundary. The DCS pipe network and plant locations are not in the supplied files; connection is only possible for buildings the network reaches.
